text: RUCKUS Networks, the sponsor entity, is now owned by Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a US-listed manufacturer, which completed its acquisition of RUCKUS Networks from Vistance Networks (Nasdaq: VISN) on 1 July 2026.

source.name: Belden Inc. (Investor Relations): Belden Completes Acquisition of RUCKUS Networks
source.quote: today announced that it has completed its acquisition of RUCKUS Networks (“RUCKUS”), a global provider of intelligent network solutions, from Vistance Networks (Nasdaq: VISN)
